purpose: Bound normal audio work and refresh the app after a successful episode
behavior: Up to five reads for an item not yet visible on the actual LIVE endpoint, with bounded increasing waits. Access, quota and transport errors do not become blind retries.

A normal attempt retains its start/stage and paid-call evidence. Its ownership fence records a failure after eight minutes instead of leaving it processing indefinitely. A late result cannot replace that failure.
Provider calls have individual timeouts and a shared synthesis deadline. Uncertain TTS outcomes are never automatically synthesized again.
The existing 80 percent quota ceiling includes the complete requested text. Unknown usage never authorizes a paid call.
A successful new normal episode sends the existing silent refresh to update the app. Recovery and maintenance jobs never reannounce an old publication.
Voice Ellen, model eleven_v4, V.2 jingle assets and the approved outro are unchanged.
limits: The next real article has not been published as a test. Its actual unattended delivery is not claimed in advance.
No new provider budget, paid maintenance, credentials, ACL access, ChatGPT automation or user notification preference was enabled.
